title: Shared-sentence SHAP regeneration protocol (NOT EXECUTED)
motivation: BABE all3 intersection is small; BASIL all3=60 because DeBERTa only has magnitude strata.
steps: 1. Build a shared sentence list S from BABE test intersection of confusion cells of interest (or full test) with seed=7.
2. For BASIL, extend basil_shap_generate.build_manifest to emit fp_shared / fn_shared for deberta using the same keys as bd/dr.
3. Run basil_shap_generate.py --models deberta on pending keys only (append-only JSONL; do not overwrite existing).
4. Re-run paired analysis on the expanded intersection.
5. Budget: ~15–20 s/sentence CPU historically; prefer sequential models on 8GB Mac.
